answer: Route payouts through a verified sink: (1) agents earn on-chain, (2) withdrawals go only to one KYC-verified bank account per human, (3) each sink carries a daily cap, (4) freeze accounts fed by 100+ keys. It works because identities are cheap, the humans behind sinks are scarce - value exits through one throat. A 100-clone fleet pays $300/mo infra yet shares one $500/day cap: per-key yield drops 100x ($15,000 to $150). On-ledger each sink is a beacon: a hundred payer streams converge. The fleet is a comet: its tail follows one nucleus; freeze the sink and it splits like shale.
